note: We Mega Menu layers a mega-menu builder on top of core menus. It is NOT a config entity and ships NO config schema, NO Drush, and NO plugin types. Per-menu layout is stored as a JSON string in a custom DB table `we_megamenu` keyed by (menu_name, theme) in the data_config column; the static helper class \Drupal\we_megamenu\WeMegaMenuBuilder (loadConfig/saveConfig/initMegamenu) is the programmatic entry point. The JSON has menu_config (per-item rows/columns/embedded blocks/icons) and block_config (render behavior: style, animation, delay, duration, action = hover|clicked, auto-mobile-collapse). The front end renders via a derivative Block plugin we_megamenu_block:<menu> placed in a region, through a stack of theme hooks (we_megamenu_frontend -> ul/li/submenu/row/col/subul/block) with Twig in templates/. One permission: administer we_megamenu (restrict access), gating the builder at /admin/structure/we-mega-menu. One invited hook: hook_megamenu_manipulators_alter(). Medium/hard cases are grounded against a namespaced menu (we_mm_*) and its real we_megamenu table row / placed block.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module We Mega Menu (we_megamenu), where and how is a menu's mega-menu layout stored? It is not a config entity - name the storage and what it is keyed by.
evals.expected_output: It is stored in a custom database table named `we_megamenu` (defined in we_megamenu.install), keyed by the composite primary key (menu_name, theme). The layout + behavior is a JSON string in the `data_config` column. It is NOT a config entity and is not exported with drush cex; WeMegaMenuBuilder::loadConfig()/saveConfig() read and write it.

evals.prompt: I enabled We Mega Menu on Drupal 11 and configured a menu in its builder, but nothing shows on the site. What do I need to place to actually render the mega menu on the front end, and what is that block's plugin id for the Main navigation menu?
evals.expected_output: You must place the derived 'Mega Menu' block in a region (Block layout > Place block, category 'Drupal 8 Mega Menu'). The plugin is a derivative block with one variant per menu: we_megamenu_block:<menu_name>, so for the Main navigation it is we_megamenu_block:main.

evals.prompt: Which permission controls access to the We Mega Menu builder, and at what admin path is the builder/listing found?
evals.expected_output: The single permission 'administer we_megamenu' (defined in we_megamenu.permissions.yml, restrict access: TRUE) gates every builder route. The listing is at /admin/structure/we-mega-menu (route we_megamenu.admin) and per-menu config at /admin/structure/we-mega-menu/{menu_name}/config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the menu with machine name we_mm_menu has a We Mega Menu layout stored. Inspect the live site and tell me whether its dropdowns are set to open on hover or on click.
evals.expected_output: It opens on click: the stored layout's block_config.action is 'clicked'. Read it via drush php:eval calling \Drupal\we_megamenu\WeMegaMenuBuilder::loadConfig('we_mm_menu', <default theme>) and inspecting ->block_config->action, or query the we_megamenu table's data_config JSON.

evals.prompt: This site has two menus, we_mm_a and we_mm_b. Exactly one of them has a We Mega Menu layout stored. Inspect the live site and state which menu has a mega-menu configured.
evals.expected_output: we_mm_a has a mega-menu layout; we_mm_b does not. Discoverable by querying the we_megamenu table (SELECT menu_name FROM we_megamenu) or by calling WeMegaMenuBuilder::loadConfig() for each menu under the default theme - only we_mm_a returns a stored object.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a menu with machine name we_mm_menu but no We Mega Menu layout stored for it yet. Using We Mega Menu, create a mega-menu layout for we_mm_menu under the site's default theme and configure it so its dropdowns open on click (not hover). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Seed the layout then set click behavior: $theme = \Drupal::config('system.theme')->get('default'); \Drupal\we_megamenu\WeMegaMenuBuilder::initMegamenu('we_mm_menu', $theme); $cfg = WeMegaMenuBuilder::loadConfig('we_mm_menu', $theme); $cfg->block_config->action = 'clicked'; WeMegaMenuBuilder::saveConfig('we_mm_menu', $theme, json_encode($cfg)); Result: a row exists in the we_megamenu table for (we_mm_menu, default theme) whose data_config JSON has block_config.action === 'clicked'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a menu with machine name we_mm_menu2. Make its We Mega Menu render on the front end by placing the corresponding Mega Menu block in a region of the default theme. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Place the derivative block we_megamenu_block:we_mm_menu2 in a region (e.g. header) of the default theme and enable it - via Block layout > Place block (category 'Drupal 8 Mega Menu') or in code: \Drupal\block\Entity\Block::create(['id' => 'we_mm_menu2_block', 'theme' => <default theme>, 'region' => 'header', 'plugin' => 'we_megamenu_block:we_mm_menu2', 'settings' => ['id' => 'we_megamenu_block:we_mm_menu2', 'label' => 'WE MM Menu 2', 'label_display' => FALSE]])->save(); Verify passes when an enabled block with plugin we_megamenu_block:we_mm_menu2 exists.
